apps.name: PlaneGuessr
apps.versionDescription: GeoGuessr but for planes. Guess the airport from a real JetPhotos shot. Liquid Glass UI, Apple Maps base layer.
apps.localizedDescription: You get a real aircraft photo pulled live from JetAPI (JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 data). Drop a pin on Apple Maps where you think it was taken, score by distance.
